$comment: Delivery budgets for the supported install scenarios, measured by scripts/registry-footprint-report.mjs against the committed payloads in public/r. Every ceiling is the measured value plus roughly 15 percent headroom, never a round number, so a regression has to be real before it trips. `measured` beside each scenario records the value the ceiling was set from. The baseline block records the pre-change measurement the ceilings were lowered from: it is evidence, not a rule.

foundation.$comment: The base item alone: what every consumer pays before choosing anything, and the denominator every other scenario is a multiple of.

static.$comment: A layout-only entry. It must stay a small multiple of the foundation it shares, and must resolve no animation or 3D runtime at all.

button.$comment: The catalogue's most-installed entry, and until now the one scenario with no budget at all. It genuinely imports the press-motion helpers, so it legitimately pays for them; what it must never do again is drag in the glyph catalogue, the 3D runtime or the other 170 components' paint.

icon.$comment: The optional icon entry. This is the only scenario that installs the shared glyph geometry, so it is the one that must pay for it.

motion.$comment: An animated entry. It must declare the animation runtime rather than inherit it by accident.

mixed.$comment: Everything at once. It must not exceed the most expensive single scenario by more than the shared foundation, which is what proves the payloads really do overlap rather than add up.

baseline.$comment: Before the foundation, icon-geometry, shared-helper and shared-paint-sheet split: one entry installed the whole private library. Reproducible by re-running this suite's script and the same scenario definitions over the committed pre-change payloads (`git archive HEAD public/r`), which is what `artifacts/w02/footprint-B0-pre-icon.json` recorded. Corrected 2026-09-23 during the frozen-candidate verification: the `button` row had been recorded as a copy of `static` (73 / 1,196,057), understating the real pre-change button install (78 / 1,226,736), and `foundation`, `icon`, `motion` and `mixed` had drifted from the artifact they cite. Every row below now re-measures exactly from `HEAD`.
